name: Sthenoi
body:
Sthenoi
CR 1/2

A woman with slitted reptilian pupils looks at you warily from under a tuft of dark, braided hair.

XP 200
Sthenoi sorcerer 1
N Medium humanoid (sthenoid)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 12, flat-footed 10 (+2 Dex)
hp 8 (1d6+2)
Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +2; +1 racial vs. poison Immune paralysis, petrification

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee dagger +2 (1d4-2/19-20)
Ranged dagger +2 (1d4-2/19-20) or light crossbow +2 (1d8/19-20)
Special Attacks calcifying gaze 1/day, serpent’s fang 7/day +2 (1d4-2 plus poison)
Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 1st; concentration +4)

1st (4/day)—charm person (DC 15), stunning barrier (DC 15) (At will)—detect magic, detect poison, daze (DC 14), read magic

Bloodline Serpentine

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 13, Wis 10, Cha 17
Base Atk +0; CMB +8; CMD 10
Feats Eschew MaterialsB, Weapon Finesse
Skills Diplomacy +7, Knowledge (arcana) +5, Spellcraft +5
Languages Common, Draconic
SQ bloodline arcana (affect animals, magical beasts and monstrous humanoids as humanoids with mind-affecting or language-dependent spells), snake magic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Calcifying Gaze (Su)

Sthenoides inherit a bit of their ancestral medusa’s petrifying magic. Once per day they can partially petrify a Large or smaller creature’s legs, causing them to be entangled and stuck to the floor for 1 round (DC 14 Fortitude partial). A creature making its save has its speed halved for 1 round instead. A creature can break free with a DC 14 Strength check or by dealing 15 points of bludgeoning damage to the stone hindering its movement. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary, pair, or squad (3-6)
Treasure NPC gear (dagger, light crossbow, other treasure)

Whatever their gender is, sthenoides are the descendants of humanoids who survived the attack of a medusa but were contaminated and mutated by the monster’s venom. They carry the curse of their wicked origin but may choose to use it for good and become heroes.

Sthenoides appear as humans with snakelike eyes and mostly green hair. A sthenoid can be born in a humanoid family even many generations after the medusa’s contamination.
